cues.en: When Apple announced its Pro Display XDR six k monitor at WWDC
cues.zh: 当苹果在 WWDC 上发布 Pro Display XDR 六千线显示器时

cues.en: last year, the company called it the world's best Pro Display,
cues.zh: 去年，苹果称它是世界上最好的专业显示器，

cues.en: even comparing it to the Sony h x three ten reference broadcast monitor.
cues.zh: 甚至拿它与索尼 HX310 参考级广播监视器作比较。

cues.en: In this video review, we checked out Apple's claims using not only objective measurements,
cues.zh: 在这期视频评测中，我们通过客观测量来验证苹果的说法，

cues.en: but also side by side comparison with none other than the Sony HX three ten dual layer LCD mastering monitor.
cues.zh: 还将它与索尼 HX310 双层液晶母版监视器并排对比。

cues.en: Hello, everyone. My name is Vincent Theo. I'm a display reviewer and professional calibrator.
cues.zh: 大家好，我叫 Vincent Theo，是一名显示器评测员和专业校准师。

cues.en: This is Apple's new Pro Display XDR monitor, which features a 32 inch screen with 69 aspect ratio and a six k resolution of sixty sixteen times thirty three eighty four pixels,
cues.zh: 这是 Apple 全新的 Pro Display XDR 显示器，配备 32 英寸、16:9 比例的屏幕，拥有 6K 分辨率，即 6016 x 3384 像素，

cues.en: giving us 218
cues.zh: 像素密度达到了 218

cues.en: pixels per inch.
cues.zh: 每英寸像素。

cues.en: Two versions are available, a standard model with a glossy front screen and an upgraded nano texture version with Apple's proprietary anti glare coating.
cues.zh: 它提供两个版本：采用镜面屏的标准版，以及搭载 Apple 专属防眩光涂层的 Nano-texture 纳米纹理玻璃升级版。

cues.en: The standard glass model is priced at 5,000 US dollars,
cues.zh: 标准玻璃版售价为 5000 美元，

cues.en: while the nano texture glass model will cost $1,000
cues.zh: 而 Nano-texture 纳米纹理玻璃版则要再贵 1000

cues.en: extra.
cues.zh: 美元。

cues.en: We ended up buying the standard glass version because
cues.zh: 我们最后买了标准玻璃版本，因为

cues.en: we work mainly in a dark room and we are utterly broke after Christmas, CES, and January,
cues.zh: 我们主要在暗室里工作，而且圣诞节、CES 和一月过后我们彻底没钱了，

cues.en: and we need to budget for the stand. That's right. The Apple Pro Display XDR doesn't even ship with a stand. You will have to spend $1,000
cues.zh: 还得为支架留出预算。没错。Apple Pro Display XDR 连支架都不附带。你得再花 1000 美元

cues.en: more for the official Pro stand,
cues.zh: 买官方 Pro 支架，

cues.en: or go for the cheapskate option of buying the Vesa mount to be used together with a £30 aftermarket stand,
cues.zh: 或者选择抠门方案，买 VESA 转接器，再配个 30 英镑的第三方支架，

cues.en: which is what we did.
cues.zh: 我们就是这么干的。

cues.en: The build quality of the monitor is exquisite,
cues.zh: 这台显示器的做工精致，

cues.en: with meticulously rounded corners and precise edges.
cues.zh: 圆润的边角和利落的线条都经过细致打磨。

cues.en: The rear of the monitor sports a cheese grater pattern machined out of aluminium,
cues.zh: 显示器背面是铝材切削而成的散热孔，形似奶酪刨丝器，

cues.en: which acts as a large heat sink to dissipate heat from the LEDs in a silent fashion even during very bright HDR scenes.
cues.zh: 它充当大型散热片，即使在亮度很高的 HDR 场景下，也能安静地散去 LED 产生的热量。

cues.en: My only worry is dust getting in through the holes, so when I'm not using the monitor,
cues.zh: 我唯一担心的是灰尘会从孔洞钻进去，所以不用显示器时，

cues.en: I use a plastic bag from another TV I've unboxed to cover the screen,
cues.zh: 我会拿之前拆另一台电视时留下的塑料袋盖住屏幕，

cues.en: heeding the common sense advice to always use a bag.
cues.zh: 谨记那句常识：袋子总要用上。

cues.en: There is no HDMI input on the Pro Display XDR,
cues.zh: Pro Display XDR 上没有 HDMI 接口，

cues.en: only a Thunderbolt three and three USB C ports.
cues.zh: 只有雷雳 3 和三个 USB-C 接口。

cues.en: There are also no buttons or any on screen menu on the Pro Display XDR,
cues.zh: Pro Display XDR 上也没有任何物理按键或屏幕菜单，

cues.en: it can only be powered on by connecting a compatible Apple device.
cues.zh: 只能通过连接兼容的 Apple 设备来开机。

cues.en: A healthy selection of picture presets,
cues.zh: Pro Display XDR 提供了相当丰富的画面预设，

cues.en: called reference modes, are available on the Pro Display XDR,
cues.zh: 也就是所谓的“参考模式”，

cues.en: but again switching from one reference mode to another can only be done through a compatible Mac OS laptop or desktop.
cues.zh: 但同样，切换参考模式也只能通过兼容的 macOS 笔记本或台式机来完成。

cues.en: This is truly a closed ecosystem,
cues.zh: 这确实是个封闭的生态，

cues.en: making the monitor useless to non Mac users.
cues.zh: 让非 Mac 用户无法使用这台显示器。

cues.en: Back to the presets, the first two are Pro Display XDR which goes up to an advertised 1,600 nits for HDR content,
cues.zh: 回到预设，前两个是 Pro Display XDR，官方宣称 HDR 内容下亮度可达 1,600 尼特，

cues.en: as well as Apple Display which caps peak white at 500 nits for SDR.
cues.zh: 以及 Apple Display，其 SDR 峰值白亮度限制在 500 尼特。

cues.en: With these two presets, the brightness slider can be adjusted,
cues.zh: 在这两个预设下，亮度滑块可以调节，

cues.en: and unconventionally,
cues.zh: 而且不同寻常的是，

cues.en: the True Tone setting on the source device, a MacBook Pro in our case, would affect the colour temperature on the monitor too,
cues.zh: 源设备上的原彩显示设置（我们这里是 MacBook Pro）也会影响显示器的色温，

cues.en: so make sure you turn True Tone off for the most accurate colours.
cues.zh: 所以要想获得最准确的色彩，一定要把原彩显示关掉。

cues.en: With other reference modes such as the HDR video preset, which targets DCI P3 colour space and ST twenty eighty four electro optical transfer function,
cues.zh: 使用其他参考模式时，比如面向 DCI P3 色彩空间和 ST 2084 电光转换函数的 HDR 视频预设，

cues.en: the brightness setting is locked and greyed out, and there is no way to calibrate the greyscale or colours,
cues.zh: 亮度设置会被锁定并显示为灰色，也无法校准灰阶或色彩，

cues.en: although Apple states on its website that calibration controls will be made available in the future.
cues.zh: 不过苹果在官网表示，未来会提供校准控制选项。

cues.en: To profile the Pro Display XDR and capture its spectral power distribution,
cues.zh: 为了分析 Pro Display XDR 并测量其光谱功率分布，

cues.en: we used our Jetty fifteen eleven reference grade spectroradiometer,
cues.zh: 我们使用了 Jetty 1511 参考级光谱辐射计，

cues.en: which showed that the monitor was using PFS phosphor in its LED light source to achieve wider colour garbered.
cues.zh: 结果显示，这款显示器采用了 LED 光源中的 PFS 荧光粉，以实现更广的色域。

cues.en: The onboard LCD panel is IPS with Full Array Local Dimming or FALD LED backlighting.
cues.zh: 它自带的 LCD 面板是 IPS 材质，配备了全阵列局部调光（即 FALD）LED 背光。

cues.en: Using our own custom authored test pattern consisting a small white box crawling horizontally and then vertically against the borders of a black background,
cues.zh: 我们用自制的测试画面，让一个小白块在纯黑背景的边缘先横向、再纵向移动，

cues.en: we counted 32 vertical columns and 18 horizontal rows, giving us a total of 576
cues.zh: 数出了 32 列乘 18 行，总计有 576 个

cues.en: independently dimmable zones.
cues.zh: 独立控光分区。

cues.en: Because local dimming cannot be switched off, we created our own test pattern to measure the native contrast of the display.
cues.zh: 由于局部调光无法关闭，我们专门制作了测试画面来测出这块屏幕的原生对比度。

cues.en: We call it the dimming defeater.
cues.zh: 我们称之为调光克星。

cues.en: With peak white aligned to the nominal SDR target of 100 candelas per square meter, black level measured 0.1 candelas per square meter,
cues.zh: 峰值白色对齐到 SDR 标称目标 100 尼特时，黑色电平测得 0.1 尼特，

cues.en: generating a mediocre contrast ratio of 1,000 to one, which is typical of IPS panels.
cues.zh: 对比度只有平庸的 1000 比 1，这是 IPS 面板的典型表现。

cues.en: Of course, blacks were much deeper with local dimming in action, dropping to 0.02
cues.zh: 当然，开启局部调光后黑色会深得多，降到 0.02

cues.en: nits on an ANSEA checkerboard pattern.
cues.zh: 尼特（ANSEA 棋盘格图案）。

cues.en: To measure grayscale and colour accuracy,
cues.zh: 为了测量灰阶和色彩准确性，

cues.en: we used our Kliant K10A colourimeter
cues.zh: 我们使用了 Kliant K10A 色度计

cues.en: profiled to the aforementioned
cues.zh: 校准到前述的

cues.en: Jetty fifteen eleven spectroradiometer.
cues.zh: Jetty fifteen eleven 光谱辐射计。

cues.en: The most accurate picture preset for SDR video is naturally HDTV video.
cues.zh: 最准确的 SDR 视频图像预设，自然是 HDTV 视频。

cues.en: On our review sample, it produced close to 100 nits peak wide, and even though grayscale was slightly lacking in green, delta errors all measured less than the humanly perceptible threshold of three including for colours, which is an outstanding result considering
cues.zh: 在我们的评测样机上，它的峰值全白亮度接近 100 尼特。虽然灰阶的绿色略有不足，但包括色彩在内的所有 Delta 误差都低于人眼可感知的 3，这样的表现非常出色，尤其考虑到

cues.en: that it's merely factory calibration without any user adjustment.
cues.zh: 它只有出厂校准，没有经过任何用户调整。

cues.en: Not that there are any calibration controls for us to work our magic anyway.
cues.zh: 反正它也没有提供任何校准选项，供我们大显身手。

cues.en: For HDR 10 workflows, you should select the HDR video P3 ST twenty eighty four preset.
cues.zh: 针对 HDR 10 工作流，你应该选择 HDR video P3 ST 2084 预设。

cues.en: This tracked the PQ EOTF standard accurately up to 1,000 nits before hard clipping,
cues.zh: 它能精准跟踪 PQ EOTF 标准直至 1000 尼特，随后才会发生硬裁切，

cues.en: which is what you would expect from a mastering monitor for post production work.
cues.zh: 这也正是后期制作母带监视器应有的表现。

cues.en: In this mode, peak brightness on our review unit measured just above 1,000 nits, which can be sustained indefinitely full screen.
cues.zh: 在此模式下，我们这台评测机的峰值亮度测得略高于 1000 尼特，并且能全屏无限期持续维持。

cues.en: Even with a slight tinge of blue in the greyscale,
cues.zh: 即便在灰阶中带有一丝蓝色调，

cues.en: DCI P3 colour tracking within a Rec twenty twenty container was impressively good with an average error of less than one and maximum error of less than three.
cues.zh: 在 Rec 2020 容器内，DCI P3 色彩跟踪表现非常出色，平均误差小于 1，最大误差小于 3。

cues.en: DCI P3 colour government coverage came in at nearly 99% UV, while Rec twenty twenty coverage was 73%.
cues.zh: DCI P3 色彩覆盖率达到近 99% UV，而 Rec 2020 覆盖率为 73%。

cues.en: By selecting the Pro Display XDR mode and cranking brightness to maximum, peak brightness on a 10% window could be pushed within touching distance of the advertised 1,600 nits. But accuracy took a hit, and there's some tone mapping roll off at the top end which is not what you want when you're grading HDR videos. So I would say that the XDR
cues.zh: 选择 Pro Display XDR 模式并将亮度调至最大时，10% 窗口的峰值亮度可以接近标称的 1600 尼特。但准确性有所下降，且高端存在一些色调映射滚降，这在为 HDR 视频调色时可不是你想要的。所以我认为 XDR

cues.en: reference mode is more suitable for content consumption than content creation.
cues.zh: 参考模式更适合内容消费而非内容创作。

cues.en: Screen uniformity on our review unit was so so considering that it's only 32 inches, yet cost 5,000
cues.zh: 我们的评测机屏幕均匀性只能算一般，毕竟它只有 32 英寸，售价却高达 5,000

cues.en: US dollars.
cues.zh: 美元。

cues.en: There's some dirty screen effect or DSE especially in the darker tones, not to mention some colour tinting down the sides and darkening in the corners as we put up full fill grey slides on the monitor.
cues.zh: 屏幕上有些脏屏效应，也就是 DSE，深色区域尤其明显；此外，我们在显示器上展示全屏灰色画面时，还能看到两侧有些偏色，四角也会变暗。

cues.en: The peripheral colour tinting may be due to viewing angle. We took RGB balanced measurements from the Apple Pro Display XDR as it's being rotated on a revolving surface,
cues.zh: 边缘的偏色可能是由视角造成的。我们让 Apple Pro Display XDR 在转台上旋转，同时测量 RGB 平衡，

cues.en: and as you can see, the whites took on a blue tint which became stronger the further we went off axis.
cues.zh: 可以看到，白色会泛蓝，而且离轴角度越大，蓝色越明显。

cues.en: For subjective viewing, we put the Pro Display XDR right beside a Sony HX three ten, the very same reference broadcast monitor mentioned at Apple's launch event last year. First up, SDR,
cues.zh: 在主观观感对比中，我们把 Pro Display XDR 直接放在索尼 HX310 旁边，也就是去年 Apple 发布会上提到的那台广播级参考监视器。首先是 SDR 内容，

cues.en: and we set the Pro Display XDR to the most accurate HDTV video preset for this type of content.
cues.zh: 我们把 Pro Display XDR 设为针对这类内容最精准的 HDTV 视频预设。

cues.en: The latest macOS Catalina update of 10 dot 15 dot has changed the SDR local dimming response of the Pro Display XDR,
cues.zh: 最新的 macOS Catalina 10.15 更新改变了 Pro Display XDR 的 SDR 局部调光响应，

cues.en: so the scene from Gravity looked significantly more stable,
cues.zh: 因此《地心引力》中的这个场景看起来稳定多了，

cues.en: although there's still some mild luminance fluctuation and darkening in the corners.
cues.zh: 尽管边缘四角仍有一些轻微的亮度波动和变暗现象。

cues.en: Blacks looked closer to dark grey than inky black, resulting in a washed appearance which is what we normally see from IPS LCD displays.
cues.zh: 黑色看起来更接近深灰色，而不是墨黑色，导致画面显得发白，这是我们通常在IPS LCD显示器上看到的现象。

cues.en: The Pro Display XDR fared better on brighter scenes, with memory colours such as skin tones and foliage appearing suitably natural.
cues.zh: Pro Display XDR在较亮场景中表现更好，肤色和植物等记忆色看起来相当自然。

cues.en: To assess HDR output, we selected the HDR video reference preset.
cues.zh: 为了评估HDR输出，我们选择了HDR视频参考预设。

cues.en: In HDR mode, since local dimming has to work much harder to not only hit 1,000 nits of peak brightness but also maintain deep blacks,
cues.zh: 在HDR模式下，由于局部调光必须更加努力地工作，不仅要达到1000尼特的峰值亮度，还要保持深邃的黑色，

cues.en: some artefacts are inevitable.
cues.zh: 一些伪影不可避免。

cues.en: In this test
cues.zh: 在这项测试中

cues.en: sequence from the Spears and Mansell UHD HDR benchmark disc, the Pro Display XDR's
cues.zh: 播放 Spears 和 Mansell 的 UHD HDR 基准测试碟片片段时，Pro Display XDR 的

cues.en: local dimming struggled to keep up at the beginning,
cues.zh: 局部调光在一开始有些跟不上，

cues.en: leading to an inconsistent blotchy presentation with blooming artefacts.
cues.zh: 画面出现不均匀的斑驳和光晕伪影。

cues.en: Once the stars were in full flow,
cues.zh: 等星星完全显现之后，

cues.en: therefore pretty much forcing local dimming to be switched off, the black floor was lifted significantly to IPS grey levels.
cues.zh: 这基本上迫使我们关闭局部调光，黑位也明显抬高，变成 IPS 屏常见的灰色。

cues.en: Onto better things.
cues.zh: 接下来表现就好多了。

cues.en: Bright scenes looked spectacular,
cues.zh: 明亮场景看起来十分惊艳，

cues.en: delivering HDR impact in spades thanks to high peak brightness that's not restricted by ABL or automatic brightness limiter,
cues.zh: 峰值亮度很高，又不受 ABL（自动亮度限制）影响，HDR 效果非常出色，

cues.en: although depending on the scene, some circumferential blooming would show up around bright objects against a black background.
cues.zh: 不过视场景而定，黑色背景上的明亮物体周围有时会出现环状光晕。

cues.en: So is the Apple Pro Display XDR a viable, cheaper alternative to a reference mastering monitor such as the Sony HX three ten? As you can see from the examples I've included in this video, the answer is no. It appears that Apple's marketing team may have been a bit overzealous in calling the Pro Display XDR the world's best Pro Display.
cues.zh: 那么 Apple Pro Display XDR 能否作为索尼 HX310 这类专业母带监视器的平价替代品呢？从我视频里的这些例子可以看出，答案是不能。看来 Apple 的营销团队把 Pro Display XDR 称为“全球最佳专业显示器”，多少是有点吹过头了。

cues.en: It's like me saying I have a 12 inch
cues.zh: 这就像我吹嘘自己有一台 12 英寸的……

cues.en: A 12 inch portable DVD player. Yes, a 12 inch portable DVD player when I don't have one.
cues.zh: 一台 12 英寸的便携式 DVD 播放器，没错，在我压根就没有的情况下吹自己有一台。

cues.en: Compared side by side with the Sony HX310,
cues.zh: 与Sony HX310并排对比，

cues.en: the Pro Display XDR exhibits a number of shortcomings particularly in dark scenes such as localised luminous fluctuations,
cues.zh: Pro Display XDR暴露出若干不足，尤其是在暗场景中，比如局部亮度波动、

cues.en: blooming artefacts as well as noticeably grey blacks.
cues.zh: 光晕伪影以及明显发灰的黑色。

cues.en: For a monitor to be used as reference for commercial colour grading,
cues.zh: 对于用作商业调色参考的监视器，

cues.en: there can be no doubt whatsoever about the picture on screen.
cues.zh: 屏幕上呈现的画面必须绝对可靠，不能有任何疑问。

cues.en: Let's say JJ Abrams is looking over your shoulders and wants a bit more lens flare in a particular scene.
cues.zh: 假设JJ Abrams正站在你身后，想在某个场景里多加一点镜头光晕。

cues.en: Can you be 100% sure that the VFX you're adding in post will be reproduced accurately when watched on other displays?
cues.zh: 你能百分之百确定，你后期添加的视觉特效在其他显示器上播放时也能准确呈现吗？

cues.en: With the Pro Display XDR,
cues.zh: 有了 Pro Display XDR，

cues.en: there's no way you can tell because you won't know whether an area of light scattering is actual lens flare or just blooming from the FALD
cues.zh: 你根本无从判断，因为你不知道一片光晕究竟是真正的镜头眩光，还是 FALD 背光导致的光晕

cues.en: backlight
cues.zh: 背光

cues.en: When you take into account the colour tinting down the sides due to limited viewing angles,
cues.zh: 再考虑到可视角度有限，屏幕两侧会出现色偏，

cues.en: the absence of HLG reference picture board and HDMI or SDI inputs,
cues.zh: 它又没有 HLG 参考画面，也没有 HDMI 或 SDI 输入，

cues.en: as well as the temporary lack of calibration controls so it cannot currently be perceptually matched to a true reference monitor,
cues.zh: 而且目前还缺少校准控制，无法在感知上匹配真正的参考监视器，

cues.en: I think the Pro Display XDR is a no go for any serious professional colourist.
cues.zh: 我认为 Pro Display XDR 根本不适合任何严肃的专业调色师。

cues.en: When Apple announced at WWDC
cues.zh: 当 Apple 在 WWDC 上宣布

cues.en: a contrast ratio of 1,000,000 to one for the Pro Display XDR,
cues.zh: Pro Display XDR 拥有 1,000,000:1 的对比度，

cues.en: even comparing it with the Sony HX310,
cues.zh: 甚至拿它和 Sony HX310 作对比时，

cues.en: I naively assumed
cues.zh: 我天真地以为

cues.en: that the monitor must be using dual layer LCD technology,
cues.zh: 这台显示器肯定采用了双层 LCD 技术，

cues.en: but how wrong was I? At the end of the day, the Pro Display XDR is just an IPS monitor with 576
cues.zh: 但我大错特错了。说到底，Pro Display XDR 不过是一台带 576 个

cues.en: full arylical dimming zones that happens to carry Apple's logo and cost $5,000
cues.zh: 全阵列背光分区、恰好印着 Apple 标志、售价高达 5000 美元的 IPS 显示器，

cues.en: excluding stand.
cues.zh: 这还不算支架。

cues.en: Is it fair then to judge a $5,000
cues.zh: 那么，把一台 5000 美元的显示器

cues.en: monitor against the $43,000
